content.text: This is a clear command injection: header value flows into ProcessBuilder command without sanitization.

input.justification: The value of the "BenchmarkTest00015" HTTP header is read directly from the request, URL-decoded, and concatenated into a shell command string ("echo " + param) which is then passed to ProcessBuilder and executed via pb.start(). There is no validation, allow-listing, or escaping of the header value before it is used to build the OS command, so an attacker can inject arbitrary shell commands (e.g. via `; rm -rf /` or similar) through the header. This matches the classic OWASP Benchmark command injection pattern and is a genuine true positive.
